name: props_v1_1
status: v1.1: cannon and coconut changed; flytrap, croc and captain are byte-identical copies of props_v1

conventions.pivot: base centre at ground level (min Y = 0, bbox centre X/Z = 0)
conventions.colour: palette texture (props_palette.png, 8x8 cells, 56 colours, no vertex colours), one mesh object per FBX

gameplay: Scenery only. No prop is a putting surface; set CanCollide=false / CanQuery=false (or collide only for blocking) and keep clear of felt. Amber PointLight (cannon, etc.) is added in Studio; cannon smoke is a particle emitter, not mesh.

props.note: Cannon x1.5. Muzzle faces +Z. Blown-off plain hat lies close beside it on the right-front of the carriage (inside the footprint). 'where' in placements was beside pads 1-2; the long axis is Z.
props.clearance_check: gap = anchor-to-art-clear-rectangle distance minus prop circumscribed radius; >= 8 satisfies emptySpaceAroundPad

props.note: Palm unchanged. Skeleton x1.5 lying face up with a big (r 2.9) dented coconut resting on the skull, a small flat gold cartoon star on its front, and a plain hat on the ground beside the skull. No gore.
props.clearance_check: overlaps art-clear area of nearest pad; see deviations

pad10.note: gap = anchor-to-art-clear-rectangle distance minus circumscribed radius (conservative; bbox corners overhang). v1 gap was -1.0. To get 8 studs of empty space around Pad10, move the anchor `nudge_away_studs` along nudge_world_direction_xz (world X,Z), or accept a smaller nudge since the skeleton, not the palm crown, is the part nearest the pad; the palm fronds are overhead at y>40.

props.note: Flytrap that swallowed a pirate: only striped socks and boots stick out of its mouth; a plain hat lies on the ground. Mouth faces +Z.
props.clearance_check: overlaps art-clear area of nearest pad; see deviations

props.note: Napping croc in a plain captain's hat on a mud patch, with a cutlass beside it. Head toward +Z.
props.clearance_check: gap = anchor-to-art-clear-rectangle distance minus prop circumscribed radius; >= 8 satisfies emptySpaceAroundPad

props.note: Skeleton captain asleep on a gold pile (in a chair, plain hat over closed eyes, parrot on the chair). Faces +Z.
props.clearance_check: overlaps art-clear area of nearest pad; see deviations

previews: (3q previews for flytrap, croc, captain: unchanged, see ../props_v1/previews_props_v1/)
deviations: Plain tricorn-style hats with a brass band on cannon scene, flytrap, croc, coconut skeleton and captain; no skull and crossbones, no flags anywhere (sheet sketches show skull-and-crossbones hats; replaced).

Actual footprints differ from the placements estimates: cannon 14.9x20.7 (long axis Z, with ramrod/scorch/ball stack) vs 14x7; croc 27x40 incl. mud patch vs 40x16 (rotate yaw so Z is the long axis); coconut 21.7x20.8 incl. palm crown vs 16x16; flytrap 20.4x26.6 incl. leaves and hat vs 20x20; captain 24.7x23.3 vs 24x24.
Extras added to make the gags read: cannon hat, ramrod, scorch disc, ball stack; croc cutlass and mud; captain parrot, chest, coins, gems.
Tri counts: cannon 1,968, croc 1,832, flytrap 2,240 are slightly under the 2-8k aim (coconut 3,526 and captain 4,226 are inside it); all five are far under the 20k cap.
Previews: Workbench renders on a flat sand-tone slab; the ground slab is not part of any FBX.

v1.1: coconut skeleton x1.5 (about its centre, shifted 3 studs toward the palm) with a big dented coconut on the skull, a small star, and the hat on the ground beside it; palm geometry unchanged. Coconut footprint now 22.5 x 26.7 (was 21.7 x 20.8).
v1.1: cannon x1.5 as a whole (hat included); the hat now lies beside the right-front of the carriage so it is visible from the 3q view. Footprint 23.4 x 26.3 (was 14.9 x 20.7).
v1.1: the dent on the coconut is real geometry (shallow gaussian dent, ~0.36 radius deep) but is subtle at preview distance.

Clearance (v1.1): see props[prop_coconut].pad10 for the Pad10 gap and the exact nudge; flytrap (Pad13) and captain (Pad18) still overlap their pads art-clear rectangle by about 1 stud (unchanged from v1) and need ~2 stud nudges.
